propositions: test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count fails intermittently under xdist -n 3 --dist worksteal but passes in isolation due to logger level pollution
logger.setLevel(WARNING) on rebar_reconciler root logger is installed by reconciler entrypoint and never restored, leaking to later tests in the same xdist worker

caplog.at_level(INFO) without logger argument only raises ROOT logger level, not intermediate rebar_reconciler logger level, causing INFO records to be dropped by originating logger before handler is consulted
existing _rebar_log_propagation_guard and restore_level mechanism are hard-coded to single root REBAR_LOGGER_NAME='rebar' and miss the sibling rebar_reconciler root
fix generalizes log integrity guard from scalar REBAR_LOGGER_NAME to tuple SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES=('rebar', 'rebar_reconciler') to contain both roots process-globally
declined count is correct-by-design when confirm_store is None (removal applied not declined), so production logging requires no change
